, GC SOI MOSFETS are better than DG SOI MOSFESTs for high performance devices.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the figure of merit for SOI MOSFETS is improved by channel engineering and gate-engineering.
GC SOI MOSFETS show better performance than conventional SOI MOSFESTs, while dual-material-gate SOI MOSFSTs show better performance than GC SOI MOSFEs.
GC-SOI MOSFETs show better figure of merit over conventional single gate SOI MOSFETS.
The main takeaway from our work is that

, GC SOI MOSFETS have higher drive current, lower subthreshold slope and lower threshold voltage than SOI MOSFESTs and DG SOI MOSFES have higher drive current and lower threshold voltage compared to SOI MOSFECTs.
GC SOI structure is more promising than dual-material-gate (DMG) SOI structure in terms of performance improvement.

the graded channel SOI MOSFETS can be a better alternative to SOI MOSFESTs as it provides better performance in terms of higher drive current with reduced short channel effects and gate oxide reliability issues.
